newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann up on share pooling speculation.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann up on share pooling speculation.

text.p: Germany's largest construction group, Philipp Holzmann AG, on Monday rose 29 marks ($17.14) to 549, a gain of more than five percent, on speculation two of its major shareholders would "pool" their stakes in it.
Such an arrangement would be aimed at allowing Hochtief AG, Germany's second largest building group and holder of a 20 percent stake in Holzmann, to increase its management control in the group.
Earlier, Deutsche Bank had confirmed that it was in talks over such an agreement, but said that no deal had been reached yet. It holds a 25.8 percent stake in Holzmann.
Construction analysts said that while the speculation was having an effect on Holzmann shares, trading volume was low and that its stock had been subject to volatility recently.

Earlier efforts by Hochtief to increase its stake in Holzmann have been blocked by German cartel authorities. The German appeal court is due next month to examine whether Hochtief should be allowed to increase its stake.
